scenario_name: Idukki Dam — Hypothetical Overtopping Dam-Break Baseline
disclaimer: This is a hypothetical scientific numerical simulation scenario for emergency planning and inundation risk mapping. It does not represent an observed historical failure or current structural distress of Idukki Dam.

initial_water_level_m.provenance: Central Water Commission (CWC) Full Reservoir Level (FRL)

maximum_water_level_m.provenance: Dam Crest Level / Overtopping Crest Level

initial_volume_m3.provenance: CWC NRLD Gross Storage Capacity (1,996 MCM)

active_breach_volume_basis_m3.provenance: Upper 35% reservoir volume participating in catastrophic breach release scenario (450 MCM)

surface_area_m2.provenance: KSEB Idukki reservoir surface area at FRL (~60 km²)

failure_mode.provenance: Extreme hydrometeorological inflow scenario (PMF) exceeding Cheruthoni spillway discharge capacity

breach_formulation.provenance: Froehlich, D.C. (2008), 'Embankment Dam Breach Parameters and Their Uncertainties', ASCE Journal of Hydraulic Engineering

breach_bottom_width_m.provenance: Derived from Froehlich (2008) formulation: B_avg = 0.27 * K_0 * V_w^0.32 * h_b^0.04 with K_0=1.3 (overtopping)

breach_side_slope_z.provenance: Froehlich (2008) recommended average side slope for consolidated embankment / abutment rock erosion

breach_depth_m.provenance: Vertical breach incising 50m below FRL from 732.43m to invert 682.43m MSL

breach_formation_time_hr.provenance: Scenario assumption: conservative 0.90x factor applied to Froehlich (2008) formula (8,561 s / 2.38 hr) to model rapid failure for emergency planning

simulation_controls.downstream_boundary: Free drainage open boundary at Neriamangalam reach

manning_roughness_n.provenance: Chow (1959) Open-Channel Hydraulics; gravel/boulder bed mountain river gorge (Periyar)
